timeline.tweet: Depression: a word I used so loosely until I got to understand it by walking in it. Love seeing survivors. Gives me hope to 1 day overcome.
I go into full panic mode when (once in a decade) a guy tries to pick me up. I’m too heavy for such outlandish behavior mntakabawo😒

Anxiety manifests itself differently in everyone. For instance, I'd go to work everyday but have had to try get myself to the restrooms where i would lie on the floor for hours, barely able to breathe. Other days I'd be too scared to answer calls or texts.

Also, its not easy feeling like you bring negativity to the people you love. We're told to 'speak about it' but you want your loved ones to enjoy life & not feel like you burden them by repeating the same thing over & over again.

Texts please. I have a very small group that I don’t mind calling me. Everyone else just sets off my anxiety. Most Times I’ll sit there, phone in hand wondering what’s wrong; what happened; is everyone ok? My anxiety has had been having me the past 3 years.

When I was diagnosed with depression & anxiety in 2016 my psychologist proposed a 4 week admission into a mental health facility. My mind immediately went to the chitter chatter @ work. What do I say? How will I be treated? I Didn’t go.

No matter how private I was I still fee humiliated. Like I’m judging myself. Looking at myself thinking ‘at your big age you are still a fool’. Seems to be getting worse the older I get like maybe it’s the desperation that clouded my judgement.
I wish I could get to this level. I’m too much of a hopeless romantic. That’s why I’m constantly getting hurt.
